# Overview

The tool below takes a batted ball, simulates its flight under the weather and spin you choose, and draws the result over real MLB fence outlines. Type in an exit velocity, launch angle and spray angle, or upload a [Baseball Savant](https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/statcast_search) Statcast search export and click a row in the "Savant batted balls" tab to load it. The overhead and side views show the flight path, the value boxes report distance, hang time and apex, and the "All 30 parks" tab tells you where that ball would have left the yard.

The physics follows Alan Nathan's [Trajectory Calculator](http://baseball.physics.illinois.edu/trajectory-calculator-new.html). Gravity, drag and the Magnus force from spin are integrated with a fourth-order Runge-Kutta step until the ball hits the ground. Air density comes from temperature, elevation, barometric pressure and humidity using the same formula as Nathan's spreadsheet, and wind is a speed and a direction relative to the field with an optional height below which it does not act.

Savant does not publish batted-ball spin, so there are three ways to fill it in. The default is Nathan's empirical estimate from launch angle, spray angle and batter side. If the loaded Savant row has bat-tracking data (`bat_speed`, `attack_angle` and `attack_direction`), you can instead infer spin from the oblique ball-bat collision model of [Kensrud, Nathan and Smith](https://arxiv.org/abs/1610.03464). That inference is repeated across several hundred draws of the uncertain inputs, and the app reports a median, a 90% interval, and the share of draws that clear each fence. Or you can just type the spin in yourself.

Park dimensions are Savant's 2026 figures (fence distance and wall height at both lines, both gaps and center). The shapes between those five points come from the outfield wall outlines in the [GeomMLBStadiums](https://github.com/bdilday/GeomMLBStadiums) package, rescaled so each one passes exactly through Savant's numbers. Nine parks whose outlines predate fence changes are labelled "outline, adjusted", and the Athletics' and Rangers' parks use a smooth curve through the five Savant points since no outline of the current stadium exists.

A few caveats are worth stating up front. The collision-model spin inference has only been checked on synthetic data and tends to run higher on backspin than Nathan's estimate, with intervals around plus or minus 1,100 rpm. Wall heights apply at the nearest of the five Savant spots, so the exact point where a wall changes height is approximate, and park elevations are approximate as well. Weather is held constant across all 30 parks in the park table.

::: callout-note
## About loading

This app runs entirely in your browser using [Shinylive](https://shiny.posit.co/py/docs/shinylive.html) and webR, so there is no server behind it. The first load downloads R and the supporting packages and can take a minute or two depending on your connection. After that it should be quick, and nothing you upload leaves your machine.
:::

## file: app.R
# app.R ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Batted Ball Trajectory Tool (Shiny). Keep this file next to trajectory.R and
# run with shiny::runApp() or the "Run App" button in RStudio.
# Packages: shiny, bslib, DT, dplyr, tibble, purrr, readr, ggplot2

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(DT)
source("trajectory.R")

ui <- page_sidebar(
  title = "Batted Ball Trajectory Tool",
  theme = bs_theme(version = 5, bootswatch = "flatly"),
  sidebar = sidebar(
    width = 340,
    accordion(
      open = c("Savant data", "Batted ball", "Parks"),
      accordion_panel(
        "Savant data",
        fileInput("csv", "Baseball Savant CSV", accept = ".csv"),
        helpText("Upload a Statcast search export, then click a row in the",
                 "'Savant batted balls' tab to load it. Or skip this and type values in.")
      ),
      accordion_panel(
        "Batted ball",
        numericInput("ev", "Exit velocity (mph)", 103, min = 20, max = 125, step = 0.1),
        numericInput("la", "Launch angle (deg)", 28, min = -10, max = 80, step = 0.5),
        numericInput("spray", "Spray angle (deg; - LF, + RF)", -10, min = -60, max = 60, step = 0.5),
        radioButtons("stand", "Batter stands", c("R", "L"), inline = TRUE),
        numericInput("z0", "Contact height (ft)", 3, min = 0.5, max = 5, step = 0.1)
      ),
      accordion_panel(
        "Spin",
        radioButtons("spin_src", "Spin source",
                     c("Estimate from launch + spray angle (Nathan)" = "est",
                       "Collision model from bat tracking" = "cm",
                       "Manual" = "manual")),
        helpText(textOutput("spin_note")),
        numericInput("backspin", "Backspin (rpm; negative = topspin)", 2000, step = 50),
        numericInput("sidespin", "Sidespin (rpm; + hooks to LF, - to RF)", 0, step = 50),
        numericInput("gyro", "Gyro spin (rpm)", 0, step = 50),
        numericInput("tau", "Spin decay time constant (s)", 25, min = 1, step = 1)
      ),
      accordion_panel(
        "Weather",
        numericInput("temp", "Temperature (F)", 70, step = 1),
        checkboxInput("park_elev", "Use first selected park's elevation", TRUE),
        numericInput("elev", "Elevation (ft)", 15, step = 10),
        numericInput("pressure", "Barometric pressure (inHg, sea-level corrected)", 29.92, step = 0.01),
        sliderInput("rh", "Relative humidity (%)", 0, 100, 50),
        numericInput("wind", "Wind speed (mph)", 0, min = 0, step = 1),
        sliderInput("wind_dir", "Wind blowing toward (deg): 0 = out to CF, 90 = toward RF side, 180 = in, -90 = toward LF side",
                    -180, 180, 0, step = 5),
        numericInput("wind_h", "Wind acts above height (ft)", 0, min = 0, step = 5)
      ),
      accordion_panel(
        "Parks",
        selectizeInput("parks", "Overlay park dimensions (up to 6)", park_choices(),
                       selected = "NYY", multiple = TRUE,
                       options = list(maxItems = 6))
      )
    )
  ),
  layout_columns(
    fill = FALSE,
    value_box("Distance", textOutput("vb_dist"), textOutput("vb_dist_rng"), theme = "primary"),
    value_box("Hang time", textOutput("vb_hang"), textOutput("vb_hang_rng")),
    value_box("Apex", textOutput("vb_apex")),
    value_box("Statcast distance", textOutput("vb_sc"))
  ),
  navset_card_tab(
    nav_panel("Overhead", plotOutput("spray_plot", height = 560),
              downloadButton("dl_spray", "Download PNG")),
    nav_panel("Side view", plotOutput("side_plot", height = 380),
              downloadButton("dl_side", "Download PNG")),
    nav_panel("All 30 parks", textOutput("hr_count"), DTOutput("park_table")),
    nav_panel("Savant batted balls", DTOutput("savant_table")),
    nav_panel("Trajectory data", downloadButton("dl_traj", "Download CSV"),
              DTOutput("traj_table"))
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # ---- Savant CSV ----
  savant <- reactive({
    req(input$csv)
    tryCatch(read_savant(input$csv$datapath),
             error = \(e) { showNotification(conditionMessage(e), type = "error"); NULL })
  })

  output$savant_table <- renderDT({
    validate(need(input$csv, "Upload a Baseball Savant CSV in the sidebar."))
    req(savant())
    datatable(select(savant(), any_of(c("game_date", "player_name", "events", "stand",
                                        "home_team", "launch_speed", "launch_angle",
                                        "spray_angle", "hit_distance_sc", "bat_speed",
                                        "attack_angle", "attack_direction"))),
              selection = "single", rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
              options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE))
  })

  selected <- reactive({
    req(savant(), input$savant_table_rows_selected)
    slice(savant(), input$savant_table_rows_selected)
  })

  observeEvent(selected(), {
    row <- selected()
    updateNumericInput(session, "ev", value = row$launch_speed)
    updateNumericInput(session, "la", value = row$launch_angle)
    updateNumericInput(session, "spray", value = row$spray_angle)
    if ("stand" %in% names(row) && row$stand %in% c("L", "R")) {
      updateRadioButtons(session, "stand", selected = row$stand)
    }
    if ("home_team" %in% names(row) && row$home_team %in% parks$team) {
      updateSelectizeInput(session, "parks",
                           selected = head(union(row$home_team, input$parks), 6))
    }
  })

  # ---- Spin ----
  # Collision-model draws for the selected Savant row (NULL when not applicable)
  spin_draws <- reactive({
    if (!identical(input$spin_src, "cm")) return(NULL)
    idx <- input$savant_table_rows_selected
    if (is.null(input$csv) || is.null(idx) || is.null(savant())) return(NULL)
    row <- slice(savant(), idx)
    if (!spin_inputs_ok(row)) return(NULL)
    infer_spin_draws(row, n_draws = 400)
  })
  spin_smry <- reactive(if (is.null(spin_draws())) NULL else summarise_spin(spin_draws()))

  observe({
    req(is.numeric(input$la), is.numeric(input$spray))
    if (identical(input$spin_src, "cm") && !is.null(spin_smry())) {
      s <- spin_smry()
      updateNumericInput(session, "backspin", value = round(s$backspin))
      updateNumericInput(session, "sidespin", value = round(s$sidespin))
      updateNumericInput(session, "gyro", value = round(s$gyrospin))
    } else if (!identical(input$spin_src, "manual")) {
      s <- estimate_spin(input$la, input$spray, input$stand)
      updateNumericInput(session, "backspin", value = round(s$backspin))
      updateNumericInput(session, "sidespin", value = round(s$sidespin))
      updateNumericInput(session, "gyro", value = 0)
    }
  })

  output$spin_note <- renderText({
    if (!identical(input$spin_src, "cm")) return("")
    s <- spin_smry()
    if (is.null(s)) {
      return(paste("Needs a selected Savant row with bat_speed, attack_angle and",
                   "attack_direction. Using the launch/spray estimate instead."))
    }
    paste0(sprintf("Backspin %.0f rpm (90%%: %.0f to %.0f). Sidespin %.0f rpm (90%%: %.0f to %.0f). ",
                   s$backspin, s$backspin_lo, s$backspin_hi, s$sidespin, s$sidespin_lo, s$sidespin_hi),
           "Uses the selected row's measured values, not edits made above. ",
           if (s$slip_share > 0.5) "Sliding contact: outside the range the model was fitted on. " else "",
           if (!s$plausible) sprintf("Caution: bat speed and exit velocity do not square (implied q = %.2f); likely contact away from the sweet spot.", s$q) else "")
  })

  # ---- Park elevation ----
  observe({
    req(input$park_elev, length(input$parks) > 0)
    updateNumericInput(session, "elev",
                       value = parks$elev[parks$team == input$parks[1]])
  })

  # ---- Trajectory ----
  traj <- reactive({
    vals <- list(input$ev, input$la, input$spray, input$backspin, input$sidespin,
                 input$gyro, input$z0, input$temp, input$elev, input$pressure,
                 input$wind, input$wind_h, input$tau)
    validate(need(all(map_lgl(vals, \(v) is.numeric(v) && !is.na(v))),
                  "Fill in all numeric inputs."),
             need(isTRUE(input$ev > 0) && isTRUE(input$tau > 0), "Exit velocity and tau must be positive."))
    simulate_trajectory(
      exit_velo = input$ev, launch_angle = input$la, spray_angle = input$spray,
      backspin = input$backspin, sidespin = input$sidespin, gyrospin = input$gyro,
      z0 = input$z0, temp_f = input$temp, elev_ft = input$elev,
      pressure_inhg = input$pressure, rh = input$rh,
      wind_mph = input$wind, wind_dir = input$wind_dir, wind_height = input$wind_h,
      tau = input$tau
    )
  })

  smry <- reactive(summarise_trajectory(traj()))

  # Trajectories across the spin draws (collision model only)
  band <- reactive({
    d <- spin_draws()
    if (is.null(d)) return(NULL)
    traj()                                   # same input validation as the main path
    simulate_spin_band(
      d, exit_velo = input$ev, launch_angle = input$la, spray_angle = input$spray,
      z0 = input$z0, temp_f = input$temp, elev_ft = input$elev,
      pressure_inhg = input$pressure, rh = input$rh,
      wind_mph = input$wind, wind_dir = input$wind_dir, wind_height = input$wind_h,
      tau = input$tau
    )
  })
  band_smry <- reactive(if (is.null(band())) NULL else summarise_band(band()))

  plot_title <- reactive({
    sprintf("%.1f mph, %.0f deg LA, %.0f deg spray | %.0f rpm back, %.0f rpm side | %.0f F, %.0f ft elev, wind %.0f mph",
            input$ev, input$la, input$spray, input$backspin, input$sidespin,
            input$temp, input$elev, input$wind)
  })

  output$vb_dist <- renderText(sprintf("%.0f ft", smry()$distance_ft))
  output$vb_hang <- renderText(sprintf("%.2f s", smry()$hang_time_s))
  output$vb_dist_rng <- renderText({
    b <- band_smry()
    if (is.null(b)) "" else sprintf("90%% from spin: %.0f to %.0f ft", b$distance_lo, b$distance_hi)
  })
  output$vb_hang_rng <- renderText({
    b <- band_smry()
    if (is.null(b)) "" else sprintf("%.2f to %.2f s", b$hang_lo, b$hang_hi)
  })
  output$vb_apex <- renderText(sprintf("%.0f ft", smry()$apex_ft))
  output$vb_sc <- renderText({
    idx <- input$savant_table_rows_selected
    if (is.null(input$csv) || is.null(idx) || is.null(savant())) return("-")
    d <- slice(savant(), idx)[["hit_distance_sc"]]
    if (is.null(d) || is.na(d)) "-" else sprintf("%.0f ft", d)
  })

  spray_gg <- reactive(plot_spray(traj(), input$parks, plot_title(), band = band()))
  side_gg  <- reactive(plot_side(traj(), input$parks, plot_title(), band = band()))
  output$spray_plot <- renderPlot(spray_gg())
  output$side_plot  <- renderPlot(side_gg())

  all_parks <- reactive({
    out <- check_fence(traj())
    if (is.null(band())) return(mutate(out, hr_prob = NA_character_))
    out |>
      left_join(fence_probability(band()), by = "team") |>
      mutate(hr_prob = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * hr_prob))
  })
  output$hr_count <- renderText(
    sprintf("Home run in %d of 30 parks with these conditions (weather held constant across parks).",
            sum(all_parks()$result == "Home run"))
  )
  output$park_table <- renderDT({
    all_parks() |>
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 1))) |>
      datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 30, dom = "t"),
                colnames = c("Team", "Park", "Fence dist (ft)", "Wall height (ft)",
                             "Ball height at fence (ft)", "Result", "Fence source",
                             "HR share across spin draws"))
  })

  output$traj_table <- renderDT(
    datatable(mutate(traj(), across(everything(), \(x) round(x, 2))),
              rownames = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 15))
  )

  output$dl_spray <- downloadHandler(
    filename = "trajectory_overhead.png",
    content = \(file) ggsave(file, spray_gg(), width = 8, height = 9, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
  )
  output$dl_side <- downloadHandler(
    filename = "trajectory_side.png",
    content = \(file) ggsave(file, side_gg(), width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
  )
  output$dl_traj <- downloadHandler(
    filename = "trajectory.csv",
    content = \(file) write_csv(traj(), file)
  )
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

## file: trajectory.R
# trajectory.R -----------------------------------------------------------------
# Batted-ball trajectory model in the style of Alan Nathan's Trajectory
# Calculator (baseball.physics.illinois.edu/trajectory-calculator-new.html).
#
# Coordinates (feet): origin at the back tip of home plate,
#   x = toward the 1B/RF side, y = toward CF, z = up.
# Spray angle: 0 = dead center, negative = LF, positive = RF (lines at -45/+45).
#
# Usable on its own:  source("trajectory.R")
#   traj <- simulate_trajectory(exit_velo = 103, launch_angle = 28, spray_angle = -10,
#                               backspin = 2200, sidespin = 100)
#   summarise_trajectory(traj); check_fence(traj, "NYY"); plot_spray(traj, c("NYY", "BOS"))
# Spin from bat tracking (see the "Spin from bat tracking" section):
#   sv <- read_savant("savant.csv"); infer_spin(sv); compare_spin_methods(sv)

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

# ---- Constants (Nathan's spreadsheet values) ---------------------------------
nathan_const <- list(
  mass   = 5.125,     # oz
  circ   = 9.125,     # in
  beta   = 1.217e-4,  # 1/m, pressure scale height
  cd0    = 0.3008,    # drag coefficient at zero spin
  cdspin = 0.0292,    # added drag per 1000 rpm
  cl0    = 0.583,     # lift model: Cl = cl2 * S / (cl0 + cl1 * S)
  cl1    = 2.333,
  cl2    = 1.120,
  g      = 32.174,    # ft/s^2
  mph_to_fps = 1.467
)

# ---- Air density --------------------------------------------------------------
# pressure_inhg is the sea-level-corrected barometer reading (what weather
# reports give); elevation is applied separately. Returns kg/m^3.
air_density <- function(temp_f = 70, elev_ft = 15, pressure_inhg = 29.92, rh = 50) {
  temp_c <- (temp_f - 32) * 5 / 9
  elev_m <- elev_ft * 0.3048
  p_mmhg <- pressure_inhg * 25.4
  svp    <- 4.5841 * exp((18.687 - temp_c / 234.5) * temp_c / (257.14 + temp_c))
  1.2929 * (273 / (temp_c + 273)) *
    (p_mmhg * exp(-nathan_const$beta * elev_m) - 0.3783 * rh * svp / 100) / 760
}

# ---- Spin estimate when no measurement is available ---------------------------
# Nathan's empirical defaults. Savant CSVs do not carry batted-ball spin, so
# this is the starting guess; override it when you have something better.
# Positive sidespin hooks the ball toward LF, negative toward RF.
estimate_spin <- function(launch_angle, spray_angle, stand = "R") {
  sgn <- if_else(stand == "L", -1, 1)
  tibble(
    backspin = -763 + 120 * launch_angle + 21 * spray_angle * sgn,
    sidespin = -sgn * 849 - 94 * spray_angle
  )
}

# ---- Trajectory integration ---------------------------------------------------
# wind_dir: direction the wind is blowing TOWARD, in the same convention as
#   spray angle: 0 = straight out to CF, 90 = toward the 1B side (left-to-right),
#   180 = straight in, -90 = right-to-left.
# wind_height: wind only acts on the ball above this height (ft).
# tau: spin decay time constant (s). 25 is Nathan's current default.
simulate_trajectory <- function(exit_velo, launch_angle, spray_angle = 0,
                                backspin = 2000, sidespin = 0, gyrospin = 0,
                                x0 = 0, y0 = 2, z0 = 3,
                                temp_f = 70, elev_ft = 15, pressure_inhg = 29.92, rh = 50,
                                wind_mph = 0, wind_dir = 0, wind_height = 0,
                                tau = 25, dt = 0.01, max_t = 15) {
  k   <- nathan_const
  d2r <- pi / 180

  rho_lbft3 <- air_density(temp_f, elev_ft, pressure_inhg, rh) * 0.06242789
  c0 <- 0.07182 * rho_lbft3 * (5.125 / k$mass) * (k$circ / 9.125)^2

  th <- launch_angle * d2r
  ph <- spray_angle * d2r
  v0 <- exit_velo * k$mph_to_fps
  v  <- c(v0 * cos(th) * sin(ph), v0 * cos(th) * cos(ph), v0 * sin(th))

  # Spin vector (rad/s) from back/side/gyro components
  w <- c(
    backspin * cos(ph) - sidespin * sin(th) * sin(ph) + gyrospin * v[1] / v0,
    -backspin * sin(ph) - sidespin * sin(th) * cos(ph) + gyrospin * v[2] / v0,
    sidespin * cos(th) + gyrospin * v[3] / v0
  ) * pi / 30
  spin_rpm <- sqrt(backspin^2 + sidespin^2 + gyrospin^2)
  omega    <- spin_rpm * pi / 30
  romega   <- (k$circ / (2 * pi)) / 12 * omega          # surface speed, ft/s

  wind <- wind_mph * k$mph_to_fps * c(sin(wind_dir * d2r), cos(wind_dir * d2r), 0)

  deriv <- function(t, s) {
    vel  <- s[4:6]
    vrel <- if (s[3] >= wind_height) vel - wind else vel
    vw   <- sqrt(sum(vrel^2))
    decay <- exp(-t * vw / (tau * 146.7))
    cd <- k$cd0 + k$cdspin * (spin_rpm / 1000) * decay
    a  <- -c0 * cd * vw * vrel
    if (omega > 0) {
      S  <- (romega / vw) * decay
      cl <- k$cl2 * S / (k$cl0 + k$cl1 * S)
      wxv <- c(w[2] * vrel[3] - w[3] * vrel[2],
               w[3] * vrel[1] - w[1] * vrel[3],
               w[1] * vrel[2] - w[2] * vrel[1])
      a <- a + c0 * (cl / omega) * vw * wxv
    }
    a[3] <- a[3] - k$g
    c(vel, a)
  }

  n   <- ceiling(max_t / dt) + 1
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, n, 7)
  s <- c(x0, y0, z0, v); t <- 0
  out[1, ] <- c(t, s)
  i <- 1
  while (i < n) {
    k1 <- deriv(t, s)
    k2 <- deriv(t + dt / 2, s + dt / 2 * k1)
    k3 <- deriv(t + dt / 2, s + dt / 2 * k2)
    k4 <- deriv(t + dt, s + dt * k3)
    s_new <- s + dt / 6 * (k1 + 2 * k2 + 2 * k3 + k4)
    i <- i + 1
    if (s_new[3] <= 0) {                       # landed: interpolate to z = 0
      f <- s[3] / (s[3] - s_new[3])
      out[i, ] <- c(t + f * dt, s + f * (s_new - s))
      break
    }
    s <- s_new; t <- t + dt
    out[i, ] <- c(t, s)
  }

  out <- out[seq_len(i), , drop = FALSE]
  colnames(out) <- c("t", "x", "y", "z", "vx", "vy", "vz")
  as_tibble(out) |>
    mutate(
      dist  = sqrt(x^2 + y^2),                 # horizontal distance from home
      angle = atan2(x, y) / d2r,               # spray angle of current position
      speed_mph = sqrt(vx^2 + vy^2 + vz^2) / k$mph_to_fps
    )
}

summarise_trajectory <- function(traj) {
  last <- slice_tail(traj, n = 1)
  tibble(
    distance_ft   = last$dist,
    hang_time_s   = last$t,
    apex_ft       = max(traj$z),
    landing_angle = last$angle,
    landing_x     = last$x,
    landing_y     = last$y,
    landing_speed_mph = last$speed_mph
  )
}

# ---- Baseball Savant CSV ------------------------------------------------------
# Reads a Statcast search export and keeps batted balls that have the fields
# the model needs. Spray angle comes from the hit coordinates (hc_x, hc_y).
read_savant <- function(path) {
  raw <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = 10000)
  needed <- c("launch_speed", "launch_angle", "hc_x", "hc_y")
  missing <- setdiff(needed, names(raw))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    stop("CSV is missing Savant columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  }
  out <- raw |>
    filter(!is.na(launch_speed), !is.na(launch_angle), !is.na(hc_x), !is.na(hc_y)) |>
    mutate(
      spray_angle = round(atan2(hc_x - 125.42, 198.27 - hc_y) * 180 / pi, 1),
      across(any_of("home_team"), \(x) recode(x, ARI = "AZ", OAK = "ATH", CHW = "CWS",
                                               KCR = "KC", SDP = "SD", SFG = "SF",
                                               TBR = "TB", WSN = "WSH"))
    ) |>
    select(any_of(c("game_date", "player_name", "events", "stand", "home_team",
                    "launch_speed", "launch_angle", "spray_angle",
                    "hit_distance_sc", "bat_speed", "attack_angle", "attack_direction",
                    "swing_path_tilt", "swing_length", "bb_type", "p_throws", "des",
                    "hc_x", "hc_y", "release_speed", "release_spin_rate", "spin_axis",
                    "vx0", "vy0", "vz0", "ax", "ay", "az",
                    "intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_x_inches",
                    "intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_y_inches")))
  if ("attack_direction" %in% names(out)) {
    conv <- attack_direction_convention(out)
    message("attack_direction sign convention: ", conv$label)
    out <- mutate(out, attack_dir_pull = conv$to_pull(attack_direction, stand))
    attr(out, "attack_direction_convention") <- conv$label
  }
  out
}

# Savant's CSV docs do not say which sign of attack_direction means "pull", so
# work it out from the file: a bat moving toward the pull side sends the ball to
# the pull side, so the right convention is whichever one makes attack direction
# line up best with spray angle. Needs a few dozen tracked swings to be
# trustworthy; with fewer it assumes positive = pull and says so.
attack_direction_convention <- function(d) {
  convs <- list(
    "positive = pull side"       = \(ad, stand)  ad,
    "negative = pull side"       = \(ad, stand) -ad,
    "positive = toward RF"       = \(ad, stand) if_else(stand == "L",  ad, -ad),
    "negative = toward RF"       = \(ad, stand) if_else(stand == "L", -ad,  ad)
  )
  ok <- d |> filter(!is.na(attack_direction), !is.na(spray_angle), stand %in% c("L", "R"))
  if (nrow(ok) < 30) {
    return(list(label = "positive = pull side (assumed: fewer than 30 tracked swings to check)",
                to_pull = convs[[1]]))
  }
  pull_spray <- if_else(ok$stand == "L", ok$spray_angle, -ok$spray_angle)
  cors <- map_dbl(convs, \(f) suppressWarnings(cor(f(ok$attack_direction, ok$stand), pull_spray)))
  best <- which.max(cors)
  list(label = sprintf("%s (detected from %d swings, r = %.2f)", names(convs)[best], nrow(ok), cors[best]),
       to_pull = convs[[best]])
}

# RF gap and RF line. Fitting the outlines below to these numbers puts Savant's
# "gap" at about 18 degrees either side of center, so that is what is used.
# elev = approximate field elevation in feet (not from Savant).
#
# `fence_profiles`: fence distance (ft) at every degree from -45 (LF line) to
# +45 (RF line). Shapes are the outfield-wall outlines in GeomMLBStadiums
# (github.com/bdilday/GeomMLBStadiums, traced from Savant's stadium drawings),
# rescaled so each one passes exactly through Savant's five 2026 distances.
#   - 19 parks matched Savant within ~5 ft before that rescaling ("outline").

parks <- parks |>
  mutate(fence_src = case_when(
    !team %in% names(fence_profiles) ~ "5-point",
    team %in% c("AZ", "BAL", "CHC", "DET", "HOU", "KC", "MIA", "TB", "TOR") ~ "outline, adjusted",
    TRUE ~ "outline"
  ))

park_choices <- function() set_names(parks$team, paste0(parks$team, " - ", parks$park))

# Fence distance and wall height at any spray angle for one park
.fence_funs <- map(set_names(parks$team), \(tm) {
  p <- parks[parks$team == tm, ]
  list(
    dist = if (tm %in% names(fence_profiles)) {
      approxfun(-45:45, fence_profiles[[tm]])
    } else {
      splinefun(c(-45, -18, 0, 18, 45), c(p$lf, p$lcf, p$cf, p$rcf, p$rf), method = "monoH.FC")
    },
    heights = c(p$h_lf, p$h_lcf, p$h_cf, p$h_rcf, p$h_rf)
  )
})

fence_at <- function(team, angle) {
  f <- .fence_funs[[team]]
  if (is.null(f)) stop("Unknown park: ", team)
  a <- pmin(pmax(angle, -45), 45)
  tibble(
    angle  = angle,
    fence_dist  = f$dist(a),
    wall_height = f$heights[findInterval(a, c(-31.5, -9, 9, 31.5)) + 1]
  )
}

# Fence outline(s) as x/y polylines for plotting
park_outline <- function(teams, n = 181) {
  map_dfr(teams, \(tm) {
    fence_at(tm, seq(-45, 45, length.out = n)) |>
      mutate(team = tm,
             x = fence_dist * sin(angle * pi / 180),
             y = fence_dist * cos(angle * pi / 180))
  }) |>
    left_join(select(parks, team, park), by = "team") |>
    mutate(label = paste0(team, " - ", park))
}

# Does this trajectory clear the wall in the given park(s)?
check_fence <- function(traj, teams = parks$team) {
  landing <- slice_tail(traj, n = 1)
  map_dfr(teams, \(tm) {
    f <- fence_at(tm, traj$angle)
    i <- which(traj$dist >= f$fence_dist)[1]
    if (is.na(i)) {
      lf <- fence_at(tm, landing$angle)
      return(tibble(team = tm, fence_dist = lf$fence_dist, wall_height = lf$wall_height,
                    height_at_fence = NA_real_,
                    result = if_else(abs(landing$angle) > 45, "Foul", "In play")))
    }
    # interpolate ball height where it crosses the fence distance
    j  <- max(i - 1, 1)
    g0 <- traj$dist[j] - f$fence_dist[j]; g1 <- traj$dist[i] - f$fence_dist[i]
    fr <- if (i == j || g1 == g0) 1 else -g0 / (g1 - g0)
    z  <- traj$z[j] + fr * (traj$z[i] - traj$z[j])
    tibble(team = tm, fence_dist = f$fence_dist[i], wall_height = f$wall_height[i],
           height_at_fence = z,
           result = case_when(abs(traj$angle[i]) > 45 ~ "Foul",
                              z > wall_height ~ "Home run",
                              TRUE ~ "Off the wall"))
  }) |>
    left_join(select(parks, team, park, fence_src), by = "team") |>
    relocate(park, .after = team)
}

# ---- Plots --------------------------------------------------------------------
.infield <- function() {
  b <- 90 / sqrt(2)
  arc <- tibble(a = seq(-80, 80, length.out = 121) * pi / 180) |>
    mutate(x = 95 * sin(a), y = 60.5 + 95 * cos(a)) |>
    filter(abs(x) <= y)
  list(
    diamond = tibble(x = c(0, b, 0, -b, 0), y = c(0, b, 2 * b, b, 0)),
    arc = arc
  )
}

.park_scale <- function(teams) {
  if (length(teams) <= 8) scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = NULL)
  else scale_colour_discrete(name = NULL)
}

# Overhead view. teams = character vector of park abbreviations to overlay.
plot_spray <- function(traj, teams = NULL, title = NULL, band = NULL) {
  inf  <- .infield()
  land <- slice_tail(traj, n = 1)
  reach <- max(430, land$dist + 20)
  foul_len <- if (length(teams)) max(parks$lf[parks$team %in% teams],
                                     parks$rf[parks$team %in% teams]) else 340
  p <- ggplot() +
    annotate("segment", x = 0, y = 0, xend = c(-1, 1) * foul_len / sqrt(2),
             yend = foul_len / sqrt(2), colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_path(data = inf$diamond, aes(x, y), colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_path(data = inf$arc, aes(x, y), colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.4)
  if (length(teams)) {
    p <- p + geom_path(data = park_outline(teams), aes(x, y, colour = label),
                       linewidth = 0.9)
  }
  if (!is.null(band)) {     # spin-uncertainty paths and their landing points
    p <- p +
      geom_path(data = band, aes(x, y, group = draw), colour = "grey35", alpha = 0.18,
                linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_point(data = band |> group_by(draw) |> slice_tail(n = 1), aes(x, y),
                 colour = "#E4572E", alpha = 0.45, size = 1.2)
  }
  p +
    geom_path(data = traj, aes(x, y), colour = "black", linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_point(data = land, aes(x, y), shape = 21, fill = "#E4572E",
               colour = "black", size = 3.5) +
    annotate("label", x = land$x, y = land$y + 22, size = 3.6,
             label = sprintf("%.0f ft", land$dist)) +
    coord_fixed(xlim = c(-reach, reach) * 0.78, ylim = c(-15, reach + 25)) +
    scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = NULL) +
    labs(title = title, x = "ft (LF side | RF side)", y = "ft toward CF") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical",
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

# Side view: height vs. horizontal distance, with each park's wall where the
# ball crosses it.
plot_side <- function(traj, teams = NULL, title = NULL, band = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot(traj, aes(dist, z)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey55")
  if (!is.null(band)) {
    p <- p + geom_path(data = band, aes(dist, z, group = draw), colour = "grey35",
                       alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4)
  }
  p <- p +
    geom_path(linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_point(data = slice_max(traj, z, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE), shape = 21,
               fill = "white", size = 2.5) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1, ylim = c(0, max(traj$z, band$z) * 1.15)) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Distance from home plate (ft)", y = "Height (ft)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical",
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  if (length(teams)) {
    walls <- check_fence(traj, teams) |>
      mutate(label = paste0(team, " - ", park, " (", result, ")"))
    p <- p +
      geom_segment(data = walls, aes(x = fence_dist, xend = fence_dist, y = 0,
                                     yend = wall_height, colour = label),
                   linewidth = 2) +
      .park_scale(teams)
  }
  p
}

# ---- Spin from bat tracking (collision model) ---------------------------------
# Infers batted-ball spin from Savant's bat-tracking columns (bat_speed,
# attack_angle, attack_direction) plus the pitch and the measured exit velocity,
# launch angle and spray angle, using the oblique ball-bat collision model of
# Kensrud, Nathan & Smith (arXiv:1610.03464).
#
# How it works. The ball's change in velocity (exit minus pitch) is known from
# the data, and that change is the impulse the bat delivered. Spin is produced
# by the part of that impulse that acts tangentially at the contact point:
#     delta_omega = -(n x delta_v) / (alpha * r)
# where n is the unit vector from the bat's centre to the ball's centre. The
# model's tangential law (tangential "bounce" e_x) fixes n:
#     n  is parallel to  delta_v + k * (v_pitch - v_bat + r * (n x omega_pitch)),
#     k = (1 + e_x) * alpha / ((1 + alpha) * (1 + r_x)).
# If that asks for more friction than is available (large offsets: pop-ups,
# choppers), the ball slides and the tangential impulse is capped at mu times
# the normal impulse.
#
# What it does not know, and how the error bars cover it. Every quantity below
# is drawn from a distribution and the inference is repeated for each draw;
# the reported interval is the 5th-95th percentile of the results. The spreads
# are judgement calls, not measurements - edit them here.
spin_model <- list(
  e_x = 0.40, e_x_sd = 0.12,          # tangential COR. Lab fit is 0.405 +/- 0.010 at
                                      #   lower impact speed; widened because game
                                      #   speeds are untested.
  r_x = 0.20, r_x_sd = 0.05,          # bat recoil factor for the tangential direction
                                      #   (depends on the bat; assumed).
  mu_lo = 0.35, mu_hi = 0.65,         # ball-bat friction coefficient (about 0.5).
  bat_scale = 1.00, bat_scale_sd = 0.07,  # bat speed at the impact point relative to
                                      #   the reported sweet-spot speed.
  attack_angle_sd = 2, attack_dir_sd = 3, # deg, bat-tracking measurement noise.
  ev_sd = 1, la_sd = 0.5, spray_sd = 4,   # mph, deg, deg. Spray comes from hc_x/hc_y
                                      #   (where the ball was fielded), hence wide.
  pitch_spin_default = 2200,          # rpm, used when release_spin_rate is missing.
  active_lo = 0.6, active_hi = 1.0,   # share of pitch spin that is not gyro spin.
  spin_axis_sd = 15,                  # deg.
  alpha = 0.4,                        # ball moment of inertia / (m r^2).
  r_ball = 1.452 / 12,                # ft.
  contact_y = 2                       # ft in front of the plate tip, for pitch velocity.
)

.cross3 <- function(a, b) {
  cbind(a[, 2] * b[, 3] - a[, 3] * b[, 2],
        a[, 3] * b[, 1] - a[, 1] * b[, 3],
        a[, 1] * b[, 2] - a[, 2] * b[, 1])
}
.unit3 <- function(a) a / sqrt(rowSums(a^2))
.dir3 <- function(elev_deg, azim_deg) {     # azimuth: 0 = toward CF, + = toward RF
  e <- elev_deg * pi / 180; a <- azim_deg * pi / 180
  cbind(cos(e) * sin(a), cos(e) * cos(a), sin(e))
}

# Core solver, vectorised over rows of n x 3 matrices (ft/s, rad/s).
.solve_spin <- function(v_pitch, v_bat, v_exit, w_pitch, e_x, r_x, mu, pars = spin_model) {
  al <- pars$alpha; r <- pars$r_ball
  k  <- (1 + e_x) * al / ((1 + al) * (1 + r_x))
  dv <- v_exit - v_pitch
  n  <- .unit3(dv + k * (v_pitch - v_bat))
  for (i in 1:4) n <- .unit3(dv + k * (v_pitch - v_bat + r * .cross3(n, w_pitch)))
  dvn  <- rowSums(dv * n)
  tanv <- dv - dvn * n
  rho  <- sqrt(rowSums(tanv^2)) / dvn
  slip <- !is.finite(rho) | rho > mu | dvn <= 0
  if (any(slip)) {                           # sliding contact: cap at friction limit
    dvh <- .unit3(dv)
    e   <- n - rowSums(n * dvh) * dvh
    e   <- e / pmax(sqrt(rowSums(e^2)), 1e-12)
    g   <- atan(mu)
    n_slip <- cos(g) * dvh + sin(g) * e
    n[slip, ] <- n_slip[slip, ]
  }
  w_exit <- w_pitch - .cross3(n, dv) / (al * r)
  vbn <- rowSums(v_bat * n); vpn <- rowSums(v_pitch * n)
  list(w = w_exit, n = n, slip = slip,
       q = (rowSums(v_exit * n) - vbn) / (vbn - vpn))   # implied collision efficiency
}

# Split a spin vector (rad/s) into the back / side / gyro components that
# simulate_trajectory() expects (rpm).
.spin_components <- function(w, launch_angle, spray_angle) {
  th <- rep_len(launch_angle, nrow(w)) * pi / 180
  ph <- rep_len(spray_angle, nrow(w)) * pi / 180
  b <- cbind(cos(ph), -sin(ph), 0)
  s <- cbind(-sin(th) * sin(ph), -sin(th) * cos(ph), cos(th))
  g <- cbind(cos(th) * sin(ph), cos(th) * cos(ph), sin(th))
  tibble(backspin = rowSums(w * b), sidespin = rowSums(w * s),
         gyrospin = rowSums(w * g)) * 30 / pi
}

# Pitch velocity (ft/s) where the bat meets it, from the Savant kinematics
# columns; falls back to release speed and a typical 6-degree descent.
.pitch_velocity <- function(row, pars = spin_model) {
  kin <- c("vx0", "vy0", "vz0", "ax", "ay", "az")
  if (all(kin %in% names(row)) && !anyNA(unlist(row[kin]))) {
    vy <- -sqrt(row$vy0^2 - 2 * row$ay * (50 - pars$contact_y))
    t  <- (vy - row$vy0) / row$ay
    return(c(row$vx0 + row$ax * t, vy, row$vz0 + row$az * t))
  }
  rs <- if ("release_speed" %in% names(row) && !is.na(row$release_speed)) row$release_speed else 90
  sp <- rs * 0.92 * nathan_const$mph_to_fps
  c(0, -sp * cos(6 * pi / 180), -sp * sin(6 * pi / 180))
}

spin_inputs_ok <- function(row) {
  need <- c("bat_speed", "attack_angle", "attack_dir_pull", "launch_speed",
            "launch_angle", "spray_angle")
  all(need %in% names(row)) && !anyNA(unlist(row[need]))
}

# Monte Carlo spin inference for ONE batted ball (a one-row data frame from
# read_savant()). Returns one row per draw: backspin, sidespin, gyrospin (rpm),
# q (implied collision efficiency) and slip (sliding contact?).
infer_spin_draws <- function(row, n_draws = 400, pars = spin_model, seed = 1) {
  stopifnot(nrow(row) == 1)
  if (!spin_inputs_ok(row)) stop("Row lacks bat-tracking columns (bat_speed, attack_angle, attack_direction).")
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  n <- n_draws; fps <- nathan_const$mph_to_fps
  stand_sign <- if ("stand" %in% names(row) && identical(row$stand, "L")) 1 else -1  # pull side: L -> RF (+)

  ev    <- rnorm(n, row$launch_speed, pars$ev_sd)
  la    <- rnorm(n, row$launch_angle, pars$la_sd)
  spray <- rnorm(n, row$spray_angle, pars$spray_sd)
  v_exit <- ev * fps * .dir3(la, spray)

  bs <- row$bat_speed * rnorm(n, pars$bat_scale, pars$bat_scale_sd)
  aa <- rnorm(n, row$attack_angle, pars$attack_angle_sd)
  ad <- rnorm(n, row$attack_dir_pull, pars$attack_dir_sd) * stand_sign
  v_bat <- bs * fps * .dir3(aa, ad)

  vp <- .pitch_velocity(row, pars)
  v_pitch <- matrix(vp, n, 3, byrow = TRUE)

  has_spin <- all(c("release_spin_rate", "spin_axis") %in% names(row)) &&
    !is.na(row$release_spin_rate) && !is.na(row$spin_axis)
  rate <- if (has_spin) row$release_spin_rate else rnorm(n, pars$pitch_spin_default, 300)
  axis <- if (has_spin) rnorm(n, row$spin_axis, pars$spin_axis_sd) else rnorm(n, 180, 60)
  act  <- runif(n, pars$active_lo, pars$active_hi)
  ax_r <- axis * pi / 180
  move <- cbind(sin(ax_r), 0, -cos(ax_r))               # direction the spin pushes the pitch
  w_pitch <- .cross3(.unit3(v_pitch), move) * rate * act * pi / 30

  sol <- .solve_spin(v_pitch, v_bat, v_exit, w_pitch,
                     e_x = pmin(pmax(rnorm(n, pars$e_x, pars$e_x_sd), 0), 0.8),
                     r_x = pmax(rnorm(n, pars$r_x, pars$r_x_sd), 0),
                     mu  = runif(n, pars$mu_lo, pars$mu_hi), pars = pars)
  .spin_components(sol$w, row$launch_angle, row$spray_angle) |>
    mutate(q = sol$q, slip = sol$slip, draw = row_number())
}

# One-row summary of the draws: median and 5-95% interval, plus diagnostics.
# `plausible` is FALSE when the implied collision efficiency q is outside what a
# real bat can do, i.e. the bat-tracking numbers do not square with the exit
# velocity (typically contact well off the sweet spot) - treat those with care.
summarise_spin <- function(draws, level = 0.90) {
  lo <- (1 - level) / 2; hi <- 1 - lo
  qm <- median(draws$q)
  tibble(
    backspin = median(draws$backspin),
    backspin_lo = quantile(draws$backspin, lo, names = FALSE),
    backspin_hi = quantile(draws$backspin, hi, names = FALSE),
    sidespin = median(draws$sidespin),
    sidespin_lo = quantile(draws$sidespin, lo, names = FALSE),
    sidespin_hi = quantile(draws$sidespin, hi, names = FALSE),
    gyrospin = median(draws$gyrospin),
    q = qm, slip_share = mean(draws$slip),
    plausible = is.finite(qm) && qm > -0.05 && qm < 0.35
  )
}

# Whole-table version for tidy workflows: adds spin columns to every row of a
# read_savant() table. Rows without bat tracking get the launch/spray estimate
# and spin_source = "estimate" (no interval).
infer_spin <- function(savant, n_draws = 300, pars = spin_model) {
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(savant)), \(i) {
    row <- savant[i, ]
    if (spin_inputs_ok(row)) {
      summarise_spin(infer_spin_draws(row, n_draws, pars, seed = i)) |>
        mutate(spin_source = "collision model")
    } else {
      st <- if ("stand" %in% names(row)) row$stand else "R"
      estimate_spin(row$launch_angle, row$spray_angle, st) |>
        mutate(spin_source = "estimate")
    }
  }) |>
    bind_cols(savant, spin = _)
}

# Trajectories for a sample of the spin draws, to show how far the spin
# uncertainty moves the ball. `...` are passed to simulate_trajectory()
# (exit_velo, launch_angle, spray_angle, weather, ...). Returns the paths with a
# `draw` column.
simulate_spin_band <- function(draws, ..., n_paths = 40) {
  idx <- unique(round(seq(1, nrow(draws), length.out = min(n_paths, nrow(draws)))))
  map_dfr(idx, \(i) {
    simulate_trajectory(..., backspin = draws$backspin[i], sidespin = draws$sidespin[i],
                        gyrospin = draws$gyrospin[i], dt = 0.02) |>
      mutate(draw = i)
  })
}

summarise_band <- function(band, level = 0.90) {
  ends <- band |> group_by(draw) |> slice_tail(n = 1) |> ungroup()
  lo <- (1 - level) / 2
  tibble(distance_lo = quantile(ends$dist, lo, names = FALSE),
         distance_hi = quantile(ends$dist, 1 - lo, names = FALSE),
         hang_lo = quantile(ends$t, lo, names = FALSE),
         hang_hi = quantile(ends$t, 1 - lo, names = FALSE))
}

# Share of the spin draws that leave each park.
fence_probability <- function(band, teams = parks$team) {
  paths <- split(band, band$draw)
  clears <- function(tr, tm) {               # same test as check_fence(), without the table
    f <- .fence_funs[[tm]]
    a <- pmin(pmax(tr$angle, -45), 45)
    fd <- f$dist(a)
    i <- which(tr$dist >= fd)[1]
    if (is.na(i) || abs(tr$angle[i]) > 45) return(FALSE)
    j <- max(i - 1, 1)
    g0 <- tr$dist[j] - fd[j]; g1 <- tr$dist[i] - fd[i]
    fr <- if (i == j || g1 == g0) 1 else -g0 / (g1 - g0)
    z <- tr$z[j] + fr * (tr$z[i] - tr$z[j])
    z > f$heights[findInterval(a[i], c(-31.5, -9, 9, 31.5)) + 1]
  }
  tibble(team = teams,
         hr_prob = map_dbl(teams, \(tm) mean(map_lgl(paths, clears, tm = tm))))
}

# Does the collision-model spin predict distance better than the launch/spray
# estimate? Run on a real export: compares each method's simulated distance with
# Statcast's hit_distance_sc for well-hit fly balls (weather is not in the CSV,
# so pass typical conditions via `...` or accept the defaults).
compare_spin_methods <- function(savant, min_launch_angle = 15, max_launch_angle = 45,
                                 min_distance = 250, ...) {
  d <- infer_spin(savant) |>
    filter(spin_source == "collision model", !is.na(hit_distance_sc),
           between(launch_angle, min_launch_angle, max_launch_angle),
           hit_distance_sc >= min_distance)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) stop("No rows with bat tracking and hit_distance_sc in range.")
  sim <- function(ev, la, sp, bk, sd) {
    summarise_trajectory(simulate_trajectory(ev, la, sp, bk, sd, dt = 0.02, ...))$distance_ft
  }
  d |>
    mutate(
      st = if ("stand" %in% names(d)) stand else "R",
      est_spin = pmap(list(launch_angle, spray_angle, st), estimate_spin),
      dist_collision = pmap_dbl(list(launch_speed, launch_angle, spray_angle, backspin, sidespin), sim),
      dist_estimate  = pmap_dbl(list(launch_speed, launch_angle, spray_angle,
                                     map_dbl(est_spin, "backspin"), map_dbl(est_spin, "sidespin")), sim)
    ) |>
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      rmse_collision = sqrt(mean((dist_collision - hit_distance_sc)^2)),
      rmse_estimate  = sqrt(mean((dist_estimate - hit_distance_sc)^2)),
      bias_collision = mean(dist_collision - hit_distance_sc),
      bias_estimate  = mean(dist_estimate - hit_distance_sc)
    )
}
